basic_details.job_title: ICAR CRRI Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for Laboratory Assistant / Field Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: ICAR - Central Rice Research Institute (ICAR-CRRI), Cuttack will hold a walk-in interview on 23 November 2026 at 10:00 A.M. at ICAR-CRRI, Cuttack (Odisha, PIN 753 006), under Advertisement No. 40/LA/2026-27. The interview is for one (01) post of Laboratory Assistant / Field Assistant in the project "CleanChain" (EAP-479), at a remuneration of Rs. 20,000/- p.m. (consolidated). Candidates aged 18 to 50 years as on the date of interview with the prescribed qualification may attend with their documents.

age_limit.details: The age limit is min. 18 years and max. 50 years as on the date of interview. The age limits are relaxable for SC, ST and OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms.

qualification.details: There is one (01) position of Laboratory Assistant / Field Assistant, with posting at ICAR-CRRI, Cuttack and a remuneration of Rs. 20,000/- p.m. (consolidated). The essential qualification is either of the following: | Matriculation with +2 vocational in Agriculture related subject OR Matriculation with two (02) years of work experience in the agricultural field with a reputed organization. | Desirable qualification: Experience in data collection and knowledge in plant protection activities. All eligible candidates will be considered equally; however, preference may be given to candidates with work experience in ICAR institute. | The age limit is min. 18 years and max. 50 years as on the date of interview. The age limits are relaxable for SC, ST and OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms. | The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the scheme/project. The project runs up to 31.03.2027 or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier. The service of the appointed candidate will stand terminated automatically after expiry of the scheme/project or on completion of the period indicated in the offer of engagement, whichever is earlier, and the candidate will not have any right for absorption in ICAR-CRRI/ICAR. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

important_instructions: No TA and DA are admissible for appearing in the interview. Canvassing in any form will render the candidate liable to disqualification for the position. Director, ICAR-CRRI reserves the right to increase / decrease the number of position(s) or to cancel the recruitment process; the decision of the Director will be final and binding in all aspects.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-CRRI Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention an application fee.

rows.details: Min. 18 years and max. 50 years (as on date of interview)
Matriculates with +2 vocational in an Agriculture related subject, or with two years of agricultural work experience

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There is one (01) position of Laboratory Assistant / Field Assistant, with posting at ICAR-CRRI, Cuttack and a remuneration of Rs. 20,000/- p.m. (consolidated). The essential qualification is either of the following: Matriculation with +2 vocational in Agriculture related subject OR Matriculation with two (02) years of work experience in the agricultural field with a reputed organization. Desirable qualification: Experience in data collection and knowledge in plant protection activities. All eligible candidates will be considered equally; however, preference may be given to candidates with work experience in ICAR institute. The age limit is min. 18 years and max. 50 years as on the date of interview. The age limits are relaxable for SC, ST and OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the scheme/project. The project runs up to 31.03.2027 or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier. The service of the appointed candidate will stand terminated automatically after expiry of the scheme/project or on completion of the period indicated in the offer of engagement, whichever is earlier, and the candidate will not have any right for absorption in ICAR-CRRI/ICAR. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report by the scheduled reporting time of 10:00 A.M. on 23 November 2026 at ICAR-CRRI, Cuttack; no candidate will be entertained after the scheduled reporting time. If a large number of candidates appear for the walk-in interview, a screening test may be conducted to shortlist candidates for the interview. Selection is then made through the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA and DA are admissible for appearing in the interview. Canvassing in any form will render the candidate liable to disqualification for the position. Director, ICAR-CRRI reserves the right to increase / decrease the number of position(s) or to cancel the recruitment process; the decision of the Director will be final and binding in all aspects.

rows.details: Form to bring to the walk-in interview

faq.question: Q1. When is the ICAR-CRRI Laboratory Assistant / Field Assistant walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The ICAR-CRRI walk-in interview is on 23 November 2026, with the reporting time at 10:00 A.M.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the ICAR-CRRI walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at ICAR-CRRI, Cuttack, which is also the place of posting.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CRRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) position of Laboratory Assistant / Field Assistant under Advertisement No. 40/LA/2026-27.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the ICAR-CRRI Laboratory Assistant / Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need Matriculation with +2 vocational in an Agriculture related subject, or Matriculation with two (02) years of work experience in the agricultural field with a reputed organization.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the ICAR-CRRI walk-in?
faq.answer: The age limit is min. 18 years and max. 50 years as on the date of interview, relaxable for SC, ST and OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the ICAR-CRRI Laboratory Assistant / Field Assistant?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 20,000/- p.m. (consolidated).

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the ICAR-CRRI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring one recent passport size photograph, original educational certificates from matriculation onwards with Xerox copies, the experience certificate in the relevant subject, the Biodata form and, if currently employed or studying, an NOC.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through the walk-in interview; if a large number of candidates appear, a screening test may be conducted to shortlist candidates for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ICAR-CRRI Laboratory Assistant / Field Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, which runs up to 31.03.2027 or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier, with no right for absorption in ICAR-CRRI/ICAR.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA or DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA and DA are admissible for appearing in the interview.
